title: Military
text: The Dutch Robloxian Military are the defensive forces of Dutch Robloxia. The Military is used to defend the sovereignty of the nation and to maintain national order. The Military is lead by the Ministry of Defence & Justice.

title: Military
text: The Dutch Robloxian Military is split up in 4 different Branches.

title: Military
text: The Royal Army is responsible for the defence of Dutch Robloxian soil and it's territories. They patrol military facilities and train at the parade grounds of Dutch Robloxia which is used as training area of the military.

title: Military
text: Military — The Royal Navy is responsible to protect the Royal Fleet and defend Dutch Robloxia on sea. They also protect the ports and trading routes of Dutch Robloxia.

title: Military
text: Military — The Royal Airforce is responsible for the defence in the air. They patrol Airports and protect the Dutch Robloxian air traffic.

title: Military
text: Military — The Airforce also contains the 11th Airmobile Brigade who are qualified to fly planes, helicopters and other aircraft as well as working as paratroopers.

title: Military
text: The Royal Military Police are the Police corps of the army. Their duties are to support the standard Dutch Robloxian police corps as well defending the Dutch Robloxian borders and government facilities.

title: Military
text: The Royal Military Police also contains the Royal Guard. These are the most Elite Troops of the country. They operate as the personal guard of the royal family and their properties and are used during ceremonies.

title: King Nicholas Goudhof V
text: King Nicholas Goudhof V biography: Nicholas was born in Amsterdam and raised by his mother, whose identity has never been confirmed, though it is widely believed she had ties to the Dutch Royal Family. His father was a hardworking businessman who saw most of his opportunity in companies across America, building on wealth that had passed down through several generations of the family and pushing his company further than its rivals.

title: King Nicholas Goudhof V
text: King Nicholas Goudhof V biography: It was Nicholas's grandfather who first dreamed of building an entire country from nothing, purely as a business venture. He secured international permission to do it, but his health gave out before construction could ever begin. That task fell to Nicholas's father, who began importing soil and draining seawater along the coast between Belgium and the Netherlands. He succeeded in raising the land itself, but died of lung cancer at a young age, before a single building rose from it.

title: King Nicholas Goudhof V
text: King Nicholas Goudhof V biography: Nicholas inherited the family fortune, the land included, and gave it a name: the Kingdom of Dutch Robloxia. He proclaimed himself king. What had started as his grandfather's profit scheme became something else under Nicholas. Rather than building the country for himself, he built it for the people in it, securing civil rights, ensuring decent housing, and forging alliances abroad to strengthen the young kingdom's place in the world.

title: Dutch Robloxia
text: The motto of Dutch Robloxia is "Leve Goudhof" (Long live Goudhof); another motto shown on the wiki is "Eendracht maakt macht" — Unity makes strength.

title: Dutch Robloxia
text: Dutch Robloxia has seven home regions: Dunhag (capital), Oysterdam (political capital), Hendrikdam, Heuvelmeer, Vaderveen (with Angel Island), Duurn and Bladland.

title: Dutch Robloxia
text: The official capital of Dutch Robloxia is Dunhag, while the political capital (seat of government) is Oysterdam.

title: Dutch Robloxia
text: The national anthem of Dutch Robloxia is the Wilhelmus; the national hymn is "Van Steen en Eik" (By Stone and Oak), which exists in seven languages.

title: Dutch Robloxia
text: The currency / treasury of Dutch Robloxia is the Royal Bank, the kingdom's in-house treasury system where citizens earn and trade; Robux fundraising is handled by the Ministry of Finance & Migration.

title: Royal Family
text: The royal family (House of Goudhof) consists of King Nicholas Goudhof V, Queen Eloise Goudhof II, their son Prince Friso Goudhof (the heir), Johannes Goudhof, Emma Bloem and Lord Nicholas Goudhof IV, the previous head of the house and father of the King.

title: Royal Navy
text: The Royal Navy protects the Royal Fleet, ports and trade routes, and defends Dutch Robloxia at sea.

title: Royal Army
text: The Royal Army defends Dutch Robloxian soil and its territories, patrols military facilities and trains at the Royal Parade Grounds.

title: Royal Airforce
text: The Royal Airforce is responsible for air defence, patrols airports and protects Dutch Robloxian air traffic; it includes the 11th Airmobile Brigade of paratroopers.

title: Royal Military Police
text: The Royal Military Police (Koninklijke Marechaussee) supports the standard police, defends the borders and government facilities, and includes the Royal Guard.

title: Queen Eloise Goudhof II
text: The Queen of Dutch Robloxia is Eloise Goudhof II, born in 1995 in Utrecht, married to King Nicholas Goudhof V and known as the Fashion Idol.

title: Prince Friso Goudhof
text: Prince Friso Goudhof is the heir to the throne of Dutch Robloxia, the son of King Nicholas Goudhof V and Queen Eloise Goudhof II, born in 2005 in Dunhag.

title: Royal Military
text: The four branches of the Dutch Robloxian Royal Military are the Royal Army, the Royal Navy, the Royal Airforce and the Royal Military Police (Koninklijke Marechaussee)

title: Goudhof Enterprises
text: Goudhof Enterprises is the family company of the House of Goudhof; King Nicholas Goudhof V is its CEO. It built the Eloise Express and bought the island of Vaderveen in 1989.

title: Huis Theerots
text: Huis Theerots is a teahouse on the highest hill of the island Vaderveen, built by Goudhof Enterprises between 1990 and 1992; it has a restaurant, cinema and private dining.

title: Angel Island
text: Angel Island lies right next to Vaderveen and is best known for its large angel statue carved from rock.

title: Silverrail Station
text: Silverrail Station is in Oysterdam; it is the departure point of the Eloise Express.

title: Royal Guard
text: The Royal Guard is the elite personal escort of the royal family; it is part of the Royal Military Police (Koninklijke Marechaussee)

title: 11th Airmobile Brigade
text: The 11th Airmobile Brigade is the paratrooper unit of the Royal Airforce of Dutch Robloxia; its members are qualified to fly planes, helicopters and other aircraft.

title: Ministry of Defence & Justice
text: The Ministry of Defence & Justice leads the military of Dutch Robloxia; it is located in the Palace of Governorate in Hendrikdam. Bjorn is the Minister of Defence.

title: Queen Eloise Goudhof II
text: Queen Eloise Goudhof II's nickname is The Fashion Idol; she is also called The Queen or simply Eloise.

title: Royal Songbook
text: All the songs of Dutch Robloxia in the Royal Songbook (the national hymn Van Steen en Eik, the marching songs and the royal ballads) were composed by King Nicholas Goudhof V himself.

title: Huis Duurn
text: Huis Duurn is the exile home of the German emperor (the Kaiser) in the forest region of Duurn. The estate is based on Huis Doorn in the Netherlands, serves as a tourist attraction and meeting place for German and Prussian aristocrats, and is also an official Roblox game.

title: Vaderveen
text: Vaderveen can only be reached by sea: there is no space on the island to land an aircraft, so visitors travel by boat, for example with the passenger ship the Mosselman which is docked at the island's docks.

title: Buizerd
text: The Buizerd, King Nicholas Goudhof V's bulletproof personal Douglas DC-3 plane, is kept at the airport in the region of Heuvelmeer.

title: MG MGA Roadster
text: The MG MGA Roadster, a British sports car from 1955, is the car King Nicholas Goudhof V keeps in his personal collection, parked at the stables of Eloise Castle.

title: Dutch Robloxia
text: Who rules Dutch Robloxia, who runs it, who is in charge, who is the boss, who leads the place? The Kingdom of Dutch Robloxia is ruled by King Nicholas Goudhof V (head of state, House of Goudhof); the day-to-day government is led by Prime Minister Henry Barkworth and his cabinet of ministers. The Queen, Eloise Goudhof II, is the King's wife and does not rule.
